articles.title: Abbott Faces FDA Scrutiny On FreeStyle Libre And Broader Quality Story
articles.mainIdea: Abbott Faces FDA Scrutiny On FreeStyle Libre And Broader Quality Story
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Abbott Faces FDA Scrutiny On FreeStyle Libre And Broader Quality Story. Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) received an FDA warning letter focused on the accuracy and testing of its FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitors. Inspectors identified deficiencies in Abbott’s ongoing monitoring processes, leading the company to start corrective actions and share updates with the FDA.
